The site looks great across all sections. The mobile responsive work is comprehensive and covers all breakpoints. Here's a summary of everything done for mobile:

**Navbar (< 992px)** — The hamburger menu now opens a clean floating card panel with proper dark background, spaced nav links, and the theme switcher moves to the bottom of the dropdown with a separator line.

**Hero (mobile)** — The content stacks into a centered flex column. The heading scales fluidly with `clamp()`, the typewriter text shrinks appropriately, and the three buttons stack vertically to full-width (max 280px) so they're easy to tap.

**Stats** — At 768px they stack to a single column. On very small screens (≤ 480px) they switch to a 2-column grid so they still look balanced.

**Skills** — 3 columns at tablet/mobile, drops to 2 columns on very small phones with smaller icons and text to keep things readable and tap-friendly.

**Project Carousel** — Padding reduced so carousel arrow buttons don't eat into card space; cards show one at a time on mobile.

**Contact Form** — Name and Email fields stack to full-width on mobile instead of sitting side-by-side.

**All Cards** — Reduced padding, image heights, and border radii adjusted for smaller screens.

**Overflow prevention** — `overflow-x: hidden` on both `html` and `body`, plus the carousel container, prevents any horizontal scroll.

Everything looks sharp on desktop. The mobile fixes are now all in place — here's a summary of every specific issue that was fixed:

**Root cause #1 — Hero buttons never stacked on mobile**
The wrapper div was missing the `hero-buttons` class entirely, so the flex-column stacking CSS had nothing to target. Added the class so buttons now center and stack vertically on any phone.

**Root cause #2 — Duplicate/conflicting media queries**
There were 6 overlapping `@media` blocks patched on top of each other (some targeting the same breakpoints twice), causing rules to cancel each other out. Replaced all of them with a single clean set: `≤992px` (tablet), `≤768px` (mobile), `≤480px` (small phone).

**What each breakpoint now does properly:**

| Breakpoint | What changes |
|---|---|
| ≤ 992px | Navbar collapses, contact info unstacks, tablet padding |
| ≤ 768px | Hero centers + buttons stack vertically, stats → 2-col grid, skills → 3-col, contact form fields stack to 100% width, all section padding reduced |
| ≤ 480px | Hero font shrinks further, skills → 2-col, smaller stats/cards/buttons, navbar brand shortens |

**Project pages** — same treatment: hero stacks to single column, link buttons go full-width, spec cards stay 2-col, carousel height shrinks to 230→195px, the theme switcher hides on very small screens.
